name: Midwinter Memory: An Ardency Story
source:
Experience a memorable holiday back in time twelve years before the events of [url=https://vndb.org/v37312]Ardency: Heart of the Rebellion[/url] with your best friend, Claudin.

See how this Midwinter celebration became a core memory for some of the Ardency characters!

[From [url=https://lacydigital.itch.io/midwinter-memory-an-ardency-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与你最好的朋友Claudin一起在 [url=https://vndb.org/v37312]Ardency: Heart of the Rebellion[/url] 事件发生前十二年体验一次难忘的假期。

看看这个仲冬庆祝活动如何成为一些Ardency角色的核心记忆！
